description.text: By staying at a safe distance whenever possible, you've unlocked the Ranger class! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
In search for greater challenge and glory you've unlocked the Raider class! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
Your innermost wish to unlock the Priest class has been granted! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
Barbarian smash! Play barbarian next game!
Decades of study and an unhealthy fascination with bubbling blue liquids have helped you unlock the Mage class! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
You've unlocked the Rogue class through less-than-honest means! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
Your vigilance and impenetrable singlemindedness have unlocked the Paladin class! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
Square jaw and thankless dedication have helped you unlock the Warrior class! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
Through homicidal tendencies and brutal efficiency, you've managed to unlock the Assassin class! You can choose this class in the next game you play.
Much stronger than other monsters
Attacking the spiky monster will damage you for the same amount as you damage it
Killing a golden monster before it runs away will net you a lot of gold
Heals one damaged monster each turn, or if there's no damaged monsters blesses 2 monsters, boosting their attack
Has a very high defence value
Each turn converts a healing potion into acid, which damages you when collected
Ignites all surrounding tiles. Matching burning tiles will damage you, and burning enemies are damaged each turn by this monster's attack value
Freezes 2 random tiles each turn. Frozen tiles cannot be collected until they thaw, and frozen enemies cannot attack
Causes poison if enemy attack hits you. Poison damage is applied each turn until you collect a health potion
Explodes after time runs out, causing half your health in damage. Explodes nearby tiles when killed
Each turn converts a sword into a skull
You cannot repair your armour while a corrosive monster is in play
Steals 2 coin tiles each turn, or gold from your inventory if there's no coin tiles in play
Jumps to a random position every turn, consuming the tile it lands on
Skill cooldowns do not naturally recharge every turn while a mage is in play
Damages your health each turn by 2x his attack value if he's in the bottom row
Matches your defence value every turn
Converts 2 random tiles into something else each turn
Casts teleport after the countdown runs out
Heals itself by its attack value every time it attacks you
Gains 1 attack each time you kill another enemy
Breaks a random sword or shield each turn. Broken tiles do nothing when collected
Shifts all other skulls down one row each turn
Moves other skulls to the tiles around himself each turn
Moves swords and shields to the tiles around himself each turn
Throws another enemy at you each turn, dealing you damage equal to its health but killing it
Can only be damaged if you trace a path through this tile to one of the 3 tiles above it
Destroys one random point of upgrade each time the countdown gets to 0
You have 0 armour durability while a Defiler is in play (your armour breaks for each point of damage blocked)
Your direct attacks do no damage to other enemies while there's a meat shield in play, instead the meat shield absorbs that damage
Moves up 1 tile each turn until it leaves the board from the top. Damages you by its attack value every time it's forced to move down
When killed turns into a Phylactery. The Phylactery respawns into a Lich if not matched with coins the following turn
You can't damage enemies the first 5 turns
-10 max health
Matching only 3 tiles gives you nothing
All enemies have +1 health
-10% bonus shield chance
-20% armour piercing
-1 armour
3% shields are broken (give nothing)
Special monsters appear 1 turn earlier
Special monsters have +5% health
Enemies don't attack the first 5 turns

100% bonus chance for tracing 10+ tiles
-1 cooldown for the 4th skill chosen
